# Getting help

1. Read [Getting started](../docs/GETTING-STARTED.md) and
   [Troubleshooting](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md); most first-day problems are an
   unapproved route, node-key expiry or a peer ACL that does not allow the ESP32.
2. Search existing issues and discussions.
3. Ask in Discussions for setup questions; open an issue for a reproducible bug
   or a hardware report.

Include the firmware version (Status page), board, what you expected and what
happened. Scrub auth keys, tailnet names, public IPs and passwords; review a
diagnostic export before attaching it.

Security problems: report privately as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

This is community firmware. Tailscale Inc. and the Headscale project do not
support it; please do not file its issues with them.
